author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists with availability through end of 2026
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please.

author: Best Verse
title: Looking for illustrator or digital artist
content: I’m looking for an illustrator or digital artist! ✨ If you’re interested, DM me your portfolio along with your rates. Let’s work together! 💌 (Prefers Indian artists)

author: La Biblioteca Dracónica
title: Se buscan ilustradores para personajes de libro
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. (Adult characters, some non-human/demons/magical, simple colorful style for humorous book)

author: nrfrh_azn
title: Looking for fantasy illustrator for YA novel
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. ✨ If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too!

author: veliraiyawrites
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! 👀 Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me 😂 See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! 🤍 For character art: realistic, epic fantasy concept art preferred (grounded, lifelike), open to styles, bonus for POC/diverse ethnicities. For maps: detailed, immersive classic fantasy-map feel.
